answer: Each new agent identity must bond a stake and solve a sequential puzzle seeded by the previous epoch's transcript, so work cannot be precomputed in parallel. A sybil farm of a thousand keys pays a thousand sequential waits. Peers randomly sample bonds and slash any that fail a liveness check. One real sparrow of an agent pays once; a juniper hedge of fakes pays every branch, and each slashed stake flows like a river back to honest peers.
